run_triton_turboquant_store: run the triton_turboquant_store launcher to store FP8 or MSE quantized KV cache entries
build_fused_store_fp8_kernel: build a fused Triton kernel that casts keys to FP8 and uniform-quantizes values into the KV cache
build_fused_store_mse_kernel: build a fused Triton kernel that binary-search bucketizes keys, packs MSE indices, and stores norms
create_store_quantized_value: create a shared Triton kernel that uniform-quantizes values to 3-bit or 4-bit, packs, and stores scale/zero
test_triton_turboquant_store: test the triton_turboquant_store launcher with FP8 and MSE paths for KV cache quantization
